verdict: Not yet. NEAR stablecoins mostly move like a trading venue, not a payments network.
vsub: 1 of 6 tests pass. 93% of USDC/USDT transfers on NEAR go through a DEX, and wallet-to-wallet transfers are only 2.2% of transfers. Failed: small tickets, wallet-to-wallet use, decoupled from volatility, broad-based value, steady flow.
T1: 93% of transfers and 18% of volume involve a DEX. Wallet-to-wallet is 2% of transfers but only 5.3% of the dollars.
T2: Volume is estimated at $76.0M a day on average (95% CI $17.6M to $235.3M). The red band, DEX flow, is most of every week.
T3: Wallet-to-wallet transfers have a median of $50.00, and 57% are under $100. That is what consumer payments look like. 4% of DEX legs are $1K or more.
T4: 31% of wallet-to-wallet transfers are whole-dollar amounts, against 2.5% for DEX legs. Humans paying humans leave a different fingerprint than bots.
T5: Spearman correlation with NEAR's absolute daily return: all volume 0.31, DEX volume 0.34, wallet-to-wallet volume 0.10. With price level: wallet-to-wallet count 0.16.
T6: Stablecoins on NEAR went from $126.2M to $132.1M over the window while NEAR moved from $1.64 to $5.33. Each dollar turns over about 74.9% a day.
T7: The top counterparty, 4a432082cc1cd551b14d6f075e9345087d64f57c2660400ef33cac5a0bb263b0, is on one side of 72% of sampled volume. The largest 1% of transfers carry 85% of all dollars.
T8: About $66.7M a day of stablecoins enters Intents and $47.7M leaves, against $49.5M of swap flow. Most stablecoin activity at NEAR's edge is cross-chain movement, not native-token trading.
T9: 47% of the sampled stablecoin flow is eth dollars. NEAR is settling other chains' stablecoins, which is a different role from issuing its own.
T10: An estimated 3,560 stablecoin peer transfers a day happen inside Intents (median $8.72, 70% under $100). Small, but this is the payment-shaped flow to watch.
SENS: Robustness check (not a test): one sampled transfer, $2.5M to nfendowment02.near, is 72% of all sampled dollars. Without it, DEX + Intents + lending carry 80% of volume and wallet-to-wallet 19%. Volume shares in a block sample are fragile; transfer counts are not.
changelist:
• Wallet-to-wallet share of volume rises from 5.3% to above 25% for a full quarter.
  • DEX + Intents + lending share of volume falls from 22% to below 50%.
  • Daily stablecoin volume stops tracking NEAR volatility (|rho| below 0.3; now 0.31).
  • Round-dollar transfers (invoices, payroll) grow as a share of all transfers (now 3.5%).
impl: Do not underwrite NEAR as a payments network today. The data shows a trading venue with a small but real payments layer: $4.0M a day of wallet-to-wallet stablecoin flow with consumer-sized tickets, sitting on a growing stablecoin base ($132.1M). The long-term bet is optionality: if that layer's share of volume grows, the thesis flips. This dashboard is the tripwire, and anyone can re-run it.
